create_desc: Hontrio creates and manages your store's Google Shopping ads.
forgot_desc: Enter your email and we'll send you a reset link
name_length: Name must be between 2 and 60 characters
name_invalid: Write your name in letters only, without digits, web addresses or emails.
email_invalid: That email address doesn't look right.
password_min_error: Password must be at least 8 characters
password_too_long: Password is too long (72 characters max)
invalid_link_desc: The reset link is invalid or has expired.
set_new_password_desc: Set a new password for your account
reset_email_sent: We sent the reset instructions to {{email}}. Check your inbox and spam folder.
google_error: We couldn't start Google sign-in. Please try again.
reset_success_desc: You can now sign in with your new password.
meta_login_description: Sign in to Hontrio and see how your Google Shopping campaigns are doing.
meta_register_description: Create your free Hontrio account and launch your first Google Shopping campaign in minutes.
meta_reset_description: Set a new password for your Hontrio account.
meta_verify_description: Confirm the email address of your Hontrio account.
accept_terms_label: I accept the {{terms}} (including the {{dpa}}) and the {{privacy}}.
accept_clauses_label: I expressly accept the clauses in the Terms on limitation of liability, account suspension and the competent court.
terms_required: To create the account, tick both boxes.
terms_gate_desc: Before you use Hontrio, read and accept the Terms.
captcha_wait: Wait a moment for the security check to finish, then try again.
captcha_failed: The security check failed. Please try again.
check_inbox_desc: Check your inbox. We've sent you the link to activate your account.
check_inbox_sent: We've sent an email to {{email}}. Open the link in it to activate your account. The link is valid for 24 hours.
check_inbox_hint: On the page that opens, enter the password you just chose. Can't find the email? Check your spam folder or send it again.
verify_resent: If the account isn't confirmed yet, we've sent a new link.
too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
unavailable: We couldn't sign you in right now. Please try again in a minute.
google_unverified: Google hasn't confirmed this email address. Use another Google account or sign in with your password.
verified_notice: Your email address is confirmed. Sign in to continue.
not_verified_desc: The password is correct, but the account isn't active yet. Open the link we emailed you, or ask for a new one.
verify_desc: Enter the password you chose when you signed up. This proves the account is yours, and you'll go straight in.
verify_link_invalid: The confirmation link is invalid or has expired.
verify_password_wrong: That's not the password chosen at sign-up.
verify_invalid_desc: The confirmation link is invalid, has expired or has already been used. Sign in with your password, and if the account isn't confirmed yet, you can ask for a new link there.
